info.name: Diplomski API
info.description: Complete Spring Boot API reference generated from the current controllers, DTO validation, security configuration, and service rules. Requests prefixed [SIDE EFFECT] can modify data or contact external systems and must be run manually against a safe local database.

item.name: 00 Authentication Setup
item.description: Helper copies of POST /api/auth/login. These are not part of the one-request-per-endpoint API reference inventory.

request.description: Authentication helper for CEO. Enter safe local credentials in the environment. A successful response stores accessToken in ceoToken and also updates accessToken. Login is rate limited and may return 429.

exec: pm.test('JWT response structure is valid', () => { pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.tokenType).to.equal('Bearer'); pm.expect(body.expiresIn).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.user).to.be.an('object'); });

item.name: 01 API Reference
item.description: Every active production endpoint appears exactly once in these module folders.

request.description: Public health endpoint. Returns plain text: 100% health.

Public login. email and password are required and non-blank. Returns accessToken, tokenType=Bearer, expiresIn, and user. Invalid credentials return 401; excessive attempts return 429. No refresh-token endpoint exists.

exec: pm.test('JWT response structure is valid', () => { pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.tokenType).to.equal('Bearer'); pm.expect(body.expiresIn).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.user).to.be.an('object'); });
